newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via three-day system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via three-day system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is expected to add temporary reserves to the banking system on Monday through three-day system repurchase agreements, Fed watchers on Wall Street said.

"Even though the federal funds are a little soft this morning, we're looking for the Fed to inject reserves with three-day system RPs," said Dana Saporta, economist at Stone and McCarthy Research Associates Inc.
Analysts at MMS International also predicted the Fed is likely to pump reserves into the money market via three-day system RPs.
Saporta said she sees the Fed facing a $4.0 billion daily add need in the next three days of the current two-week liquidity maintenance period.
At 1030 EDT/1430 GMT, the federal funds were trading at 5-3/16 percent, below the Fed's 5-1/4 percent target.
